map.缢死 vs 勒死 鉴别要点: Key Points Distinguishing Hanging from Ligature Strangulation
map.深浅不一（着力侧深）: Uneven depth (deep on the pressure side)
map.• 绳索着力点在颈前部（颏下/喉结前方）: The pressure point of the cord is on the front of the neck (below the chin / in front of the laryngeal prominence)
map.• 索沟呈倒V形，前深后浅，向上提空: The ligature mark is an inverted V, deep in front and shallow behind, lifting upward
map.• 意识丧失最快（压迫颈动脉+椎动脉）: Loss of consciousness is fastest (compression of the carotid and vertebral arteries)
map.• 绳索着力点在颈部一侧: The pressure point of the cord is on one side of the neck
map.• 索沟一侧深，经颈前绕至对侧浅: The mark is deep on one side and passes around the front to a shallow opposite side
map.• 意识丧失较快: Loss of consciousness is fairly quick
map.• 绳索着力点在颈后部: The pressure point of the cord is on the back of the neck
map.• 索沟颈后深，经颈两侧绕至颈前浅: The mark is deep behind the neck and passes around both sides to a shallow front
map.自缢现场勘查要点: Key Points in Scene Investigation of Hanging
map.：检查绳索材质、直径、结扣方式，与索沟宽度对照: : examine the cord material, diameter and knot type, and compare with the mark width
map.：检查悬挂处痕迹、高度、是否可承重: : examine marks at the suspension point, the height and whether it can bear the weight
map.：现场是否有凳椅等垫脚物、踢翻痕迹: : whether there are stools or chairs at the scene, and signs of kicking them over
map.：有无遗书、精神病史: : presence of a suicide note or psychiatric history
map.：有无抵抗伤（自缢一般无抵抗伤）: : presence of defensive injuries (these are generally absent in hanging)
map.：有无其他暴力损伤（排除伪装自缢）: : presence of other traumatic injury (to exclude staged hanging)

map.按索沟位置、方向、深度、提空（索沟中断上提）与出血生活反应分析：自缢索沟多斜行向: Analyse the position, direction, depth, lift-off (interruption of the mark above) and bleeding vital reaction: a hanging ligature mark usually runs obliquely upward with lift-off, shows marked vital reaction and shows cord fibre embedded in the groove, while a ligature strangulation mark is usually horizontal and closed, has no lift-off and shows bleeding at the upper margin.
map.颈部索沟宽 1.5 cm、呈斜行向上提空、沟缘出血明显、绳索纤维嵌入真皮 → 自: A neck ligature mark 1.5 cm wide, running obliquely upward with lift-off, with marked bleeding at the margins and cord fibres embedded in the dermis indicates hanging (a typical hanging groove). A horizontal closed mark with no lift-off and multiple haemorrhages at the upper margin indicates ligature strangulation (homicide). This distinguishes the manner of death.
map.索沟宽度能推断绳索粗细吗？: Can mark width indicate cord thickness?
map.大致对应（软索略小于绳径、硬索压痕清），但受绳索软硬、受力、皮肤伸缩影响，仅作参: It corresponds roughly (a soft cord leaves a mark slightly smaller than its diameter, a hard cord leaves a clear imprint), but it is affected by cord stiffness, force and skin elasticity, so it is a reference only and cannot precisely reconstruct the cord.
map.没有提空就一定是勒死吗？: Does the absence of lift-off definitely mean strangulation?
map.不一定。悬吊点正上方受力也可无提空，但多数自缢因体重偏移呈斜行提空；需结合方向、: Not necessarily. Force applied from directly above the suspension point can also produce no lift-off, but most hangings show oblique lift-off because the body weight shifts. Combine direction, vital reaction and the scene.
